question: In which year did Sir Thomas Roe, the official ambassador of King James I of England, arrive at the court of Jahangir?
explanation: Sir Thomas Roe arrived at Surat in September 1615 as the accredited ambassador of King James I to the court of Mughal Emperor Jahangir. He remained in India until 1619.

question: Where was the Mughal court located when Sir Thomas Roe first presented his credentials to Emperor Jahangir in January 1616?
explanation: Emperor Jahangir was residing in Ajmer when Sir Thomas Roe arrived. Roe traveled to Ajmer and presented his credentials to the Emperor there in January 1616.
